Survival basics

Claim unlocked lobby rewards before they expire

When FREE DROP appears in the lobby, check its progress and remaining time. Follow the event's viewing instructions to earn points. Claim each unlocked reward manually: unclaimed rewards disappear when the timer ends.

A skin you already own is replaced by silver. Daily point limits can temporarily disable the button, and points may arrive late; unlocked rewards remain claimable. An event starting during a match appears when you next return to the lobby.
